articles.title: GTA 6 Sets PC Release Date, New Report Says
articles.summary: A new report claims the PC version of Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released early in 2027, just a few months after it arrives on consoles this November.
body: Grand Theft Auto 6 will reportedly be released on Windows PC early next year, a new report claims.

On Tuesday, GamesBeat reported GTA 6 will land on PC "within the first three months of 2027." That's according to "four industry sources familiar with the studio’s plans" who anonymously spoke with GamesBeat. Rockstar has not officially commented on its potential plans to bring GTA 6 to PC.

GTA 6 is slated for a Nov. 19 launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. Rockstar famously keeps PC gamers waiting as it prioritizes console launches first for its games. Grand Theft Auto 5 came out in September 2013 for consoles and took over a year and a half to arrive on PC in April 2015, for example. Red Dead Redemption 2, Rockstar's last brand-new single-player game, took a a year to be released on PC after its console launch.

If GTA 6 does end on PC during the first quarter of 2027, it would mean PC players would only have to wait a few months extra to get their hands on what is shaping up to be the biggest game of the generation.
points: A new report claims the PC version of Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released early in 2027, just a few months after it arrives on consoles this November.
Grand Theft Auto 6 will reportedly be released on Windows PC early next year, a new report claims.
On Tuesday, GamesBeat reported GTA 6 will land on PC "within the first three months of 2027.
Rockstar has not officially commented on its potential plans to bring GTA 6 to PC.

articles.title: Xbox Is Testing A New Streak Feature That Could Make Gaming Feel (More) Like A Chore
articles.summary: It looks like another new Xbox feature is in development, and this time, it's designed to encourage users to go on a hot streak--of using their console, not disrupting a sports event with a quick birthday-suit-run.
body: Spotted by Game File's Stephen Totilo, a new number appears to be popping up on the dashboard of Xbox users who are signed up for the Xbox Insider program, suggesting that a streak counter is in development. Microsoft hasn't formally announced this feature yet, and it looks like it kicks in after using your Xbox for three days in a row per week. It's an idea that Microsoft has experimented with in the past through Game Pass and the Xbox mobile app, but never to this extent with a prominent display of how many days in a row you've dedicated to playing Xbox games.

Is there any benefit to Streaks for Xbox users? Totilo's research suggests that it could be tied to Xbox reward points, which can be redeemed for digital items and Xbox gift cards. On Microsoft's side, this could also be a subtle way to keep users engaged more consistently, since the lure of a score streak is powerful. Just look at Wordle, with its subtle emphasis on keeping your streak going, or mobile free-to-play games that offer daily login rewards to tempt you to sign in regularly.

articles.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 Reportedly Dead, but It's So Expensive That It Doesn't Really Matter
articles.summary: While the RTX 5090 was already hard enough to get at a reasonable price, new leaks suggest that Nvidia is flat-out discontinuing its flagship graphics card. GPU leaker zed__wang on Twitter posted about the RTX 5090, saying there would be "No more GB202 for 5090, confirmed." They then followed up…
body: For the uninitiated, GB202 is the name of the actual GPU die that powers the RTX 5090, and it has always powered more than just the RTX 5090. Instead, the GB202 powers nine distinct workstation and data center GPUs, according to TechPowerUp. It shouldn't be too surprising, then, that Nvidia would opt to prioritize much more expensive graphics cards like the Nvidia RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell, which costs around $18,000, rather than the RTX 5090, which costs around $9,000 on Newegg these days.
Nvidia also hasn't been shy about prioritizing AI over the gaming division, with the company dropping gaming from its earnings report, and working it into the 'Edge Computing' category.

But, while the leak suggests that the discontinuation of the RTX 5090 is confirmed, it is anything but. Nvidia hasn't commented on its flagship card going away. That doesn't mean much on the surface, but if you look back to February, similar rumors were spinning up about the RTX 5070 Ti, and no matter how convincing those leaks were, they ended up being completely false.

articles.title: AI Couldn’t Have Made Star Wars: Galactic Racer’s Biddy Blas
articles.summary: Epic's upcoming Star Wars shooter is reportedly developed with an "AI first" production model, which means it'll never have its own Biddy Blas, Galactic Racer's breakout Weird Little Guy.
body: This is an IGN opinion piece from Mat Jones. He loves weird little guys in video games.

If your social feed is anything like mine, it’s been overtaken by a weird little crocodile man that’s knee-high to a Tauntaun and has an unresolved rage twelve times his size. His name is Biddy Blas, he’s one of Galactic Racer’s supporting cast, and he’s the best new thing to happen to Star Wars since Andor.
Give an AI as long a time as it needs: it couldn’t have made Biddy Blas.

With every new day, the ground underneath video games as a medium, one where professional creatives are valued and capable of negotiating an honest living, feels more and more unstable. Perfectly good studios are shutting in the name of brand restructuring. Electronic component prices have no incentive to reduce. The cost of producing anything is rising due to the precarious supply of energy and the push to end physical ownership. It’s hard to imagine what the future of the medium looks like, regardless of AI’s role to play in it.
points: Epic's upcoming Star Wars shooter is reportedly developed with an "AI first" production model, which means it'll never have its own Biddy Blas, Galactic Racer's breakout Weird Little Guy.

articles.title: GTA 6 Will Reportedly Come To PC Much Earlier Than Expected
articles.summary: The November launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 will leave PC gamers sitting out in the cold, but the wait for the yet-to-be-announced PC port might be surprisingly short this time. According to a new report, GTA 6 will launch on PC "within the first three months" of 2027.
body: Speaking to GamesBeat, industry sources claim that Rockstar Games plans to launch the game just a few months after its console release. If the reports are accurate, this would mark a major departure for Rockstar Games, as previous PC ports arrived long after their original console releases. GTA 5, for example, landed on PC 18 months after its PS3 and Xbox 360 release, while the PC version of Red Dead Redemption 2 appeared 11 months after its PS4 and Xbox One release.

Take-Two Interactive boss Strauss Zelnick previously commented that PC was becoming an important platform for the GTA 6 parent company to focus on, saying sales of the publisher's PC games had increased dramatically over the years.

As for why GTA 6 won't be available on PC at launch, former Rockstar producer John Ricchio theorized that a console-first approach to development would give Rockstar more room to build a PC version later. Since consoles have limited hardware, it's easier for a studio to expand a game to run on more powerful hardware like a PC instead of scaling back to fit console constraints.

articles.title: GTA 6 Reportedly Set for PC Q1 2027
articles.summary: Rockstar reportedly plans to release GTA 6 on PC during the first quarter of 2027. GamesBeat reported the news based on four sources who asked to remain anonymous. Rockstar and parent company Take-Two are yet to comment.
body: If true, it would mean GTA 6 hitting PC just a few months after it launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S on November 19, 2026. Some had anticipated a longer wait for the game on PC, given it took nearly two years for GTA 5 to launch on PC after consoles.

The PC launch may tie into the release of GTA 6's multiplayer mode, which fans are calling GTA Online 2 while they wait for official word from Rockstar. While Rockstar has yet to confirm an online mode for GTA 6, last month Twitch boss Dan Clancy said GTA Online 2 — or whatever GTA 6’s multiplayer mode is called — will launch next year.

Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has always responded with vague comments when asked about the prospect of launching GTA 6 on PC, pointing to Rockstar for announcements. In May, Zelnick told Bloomberg that Rockstar "always starts on console because I think with regard to a release like that you're judged by serving the core. Like really serving the core consumer. If your core consumer isn't there, if they're not served first and best, you kind of don't hit your other consumers.”

articles.title: The Wordle of Pokémon Games Is Here With Daily Challenge Battles
articles.summary: Do you know Wordle, the word puzzle that challenges you once a day? What if, instead of a puzzle, it were a Pokémon battle? That's the concept of Daily Red, a fan-made Pokémon game that you can play in your browser.
body: In Daily Red, players must face Red daily using a team of six random Pokémon from Gens 1-3. Red leads with Pikachu and always has the same team as when players find him on Mt. Silver in Johto: Pikachu, Espeon, Snorlax, Venusaur, Charizard, and Blastoise. This allows players to become increasingly acquainted with the lineup over time.

Before battling, gamers are advised to analyze their team for the day. This way, they can understand its strengths and weaknesses and decide which Pokémon to lead with. They can also try a practice run before they commit to the battle. After the battle, they can continue practicing, but their result will be locked in.

The objective is to beat Red and start a winning streak. Unfortunately, it's not currently possible to make an account to save progress, but it's stored locally in the browser. Once the battle is over, players can share their grid with friends or on social media. If they lose, the grid will have red squares, revealing how many of Red's Pokémon fainted. If they win, the grid will have a green square for each of their Pokémon that didn't faint.

What if, instead of a puzzle, it were a Pokémon battle?

articles.title: 'Ruins and Reverberations' quest walkthrough in Arc Raiders
articles.summary: The "Ruins and Reverberations" quest in Arc Raiders involves a quick visit to the Cielo Sereno Observatory, which is one of the new locations on the Pendola Pass map, introduced to the game with the "Frozen Trail" update.
body: Here's a full walkthrough on how to complete the "Ruins and Reverberations" quest in Arc Raiders, including how to get a Spotter Relay and where to find the antenna and the crawlspace under the control room.

First up, you need to get your hands on a Spotter Relay. Spotters, not to be confused with Snitches, are small, flying Arc enemies that always come in pairs. Two of them always deploy alongside a Bastion or Bombardier, and they do exactly what you'd expect: spot raiders. Bastions and Bombardiers aren't often seen on Pendola Pass, so your best bet is to go to Buried City or Blue Gate. Take down a Spotter, loot it for the Spotter Relay, then bring it to Pendola Pass with you.

The Cielo Sereno Observatory is located in the northeast area of Pendola Pass. The antenna itself is on the roof, and you should absolutely bring a grappling hook, snaphook, or zipline with you to do this quest, because you're going to need to get onto the roof of the observatory twice. Having one of these mobility tools on you will make this task considerably easier.

articles.title: Sifu, the singular kung fu action game, is out now on Android and iOS
articles.summary: Sifu, Sloclap's 2022 martial arts action game, can now be played on smartphones. The French developer released the game today on Android and iOS, following an announcement earlier in the month.
body: This portable version of Sifu is priced $8 / £6, and the studio said it has been developed specifically for phone screens. The game has new touch-based controls, as you might imagine, which translate its core moves to on-screen prompts, with environmental interactions streamlined.

The ports also have a new, adaptive camera which Sloclap said works better on smaller screens. The developer said it worked to retain Sifu's painterly look, and its fluid and impactful combat for the mobile release, but the game also supports controllers if you prefer.
Judging by the trailer, it does look like the Sifu we know, albeit with a softer image as a result of the less powerful hardware.
Sifu was critically acclaimed and sold 1 million copies in its first three weeks of release. Previously a PlayStation and Epic Games Store exclusive, Sifu made its way to Steam and Xbox a year later.

articles.title: Live-Action Moana Officially Gets Disney Plus Release Date
articles.summary: Disney ’s latest box office dud is headed for streaming. A little over three months after the live-action film Moana debuted in theaters to an underwhelming box office performance, the movie is coming to Disney Plus on Oct. 21.
body: Moana opened to a dismal $43 million at the domestic box office on opening weekend, a huge whiff considering the movie's $250 million budget. While it eventually made around $323.6 million worldwide, movies typically need to earn double or 2.5 times their budget for the studio to break even, so this was almost certainly a big underperformance for Disney.

Critics blasted the film for failing to find its own identity compared to the 2016 animated movie, and audiences seemed similarly unenthusiastic about a live-action remake of a picture that came out just a decade ago. At least with most of Disney’s other bland live-action retreads, the animated movies they revisited were often decades old.

The original animated Moana and its 2024 sequel are beloved musicals centered on Polynesian culture. Both were huge hits with audiences. The first film has a 96% on Rotten Tomatoes and made $687.2 million on a $150-175 million budget. While its 2024 sequel, Moana 2, was far more divisive among critics, it was an even bigger box office hit, making over $1 billion on a $150 million budget. Both movies are a firm reminder that audiences are eager for good films centered on diverse cultures.

articles.title: GTA 3's iconic box art was changed at the last minute because of 9/11, ex-Rockstar lead Dan Houser reveals
articles.summary: Dan Houser, one of Rockstar's co-founders that left the GTA 6 studio in 2020, has given a wide-ranging new interview with IGN, covering topics including the tortured production of Bully, changes made to Grand Theft Auto 3's artwork post-9/11, the reaction to Red Dead Redemption's ending, and why he…
body: The most interesting to me is how the iconic boxart for GTA 3 - a template that has been used for every game since, by the way, most recently being co-opted for GTA 6's cover - was actually put together very last minute.

"What's funny is the cover art that became the iconic GTA cover art; Stephen Bliss did that in about two evenings because the old cover art was probably being too offensive to release after 9/11 because there were burning buildings in it," Houser revealed to IGN. "So it would've been fine if there hadn't just been 9/11. So that look of the shards, the squares that became very iconic, only appeared because of 9/11."

GTA 3 takes place in Liberty City - a thinly-veiled parody of the real-world New York City, where the 9/11 disaster, of course, took place. So there was sensitivity around showing destruction and death publicly in the months and years after. This is something that Rockstar had to consider carefully as it was launching the game into the aftermath of the event.

videos.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse Review
videos.summary: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse reviewed by Scott White on PlayStation 5, also available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch.
body: "Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse brings Konami’s beloved series into the modern era with a fast-paced / action-focused adventure. Convenient map tracking tools, exciting combat, a great new hero, and movement tech that will test your reflexes all help this long-awaited sequel stand tall in what has since become a crowded genre. But Belmont’s Curse is a better metroidvania generally than it is a Castlevania specifically, sacrificing some of the series’ signature charm and feel along the way. Even still, I would not be upset to see developer Evil Empire’s name attached to another Castlevania game in the future. I just hope it doesn’t take another 18 years to arrive – I don’t think my reflexes will be up to the task when I hit my mid-50s."

videos.title: Project Motor Racing - World Endurance Pack Reveal Trailer | PS5 Games
videos.summary: Experience the thrills and speed of endurance racing in Project Motor Racing. The World Endurance Pack delivers a blend of old and new with 11 cars across 4 endurance classes.
points: Experience the thrills and speed of endurance racing in Project Motor Racing.
The World Endurance Pack delivers a blend of old and new with 11 cars across 4 endurance classes.
The LMP1 class brings back the start of the 2010’s hybrid era with the 2016 Audi R18, Porsche 919 Hybrid and the Toyota TS050 Hybrid.
While LMP2 and LMP2 EVO introduce two new classes paying homage to two eras of prototype racing with the 2013 Olivera P2-13 and the 2026 Olivera P2-26 EVO respectively.
